name: du
summary: Measures the disk space used by files and directories.
description: Disk usage: walks through directories and adds up the space actually used on disk. Without options, it prints one line per subdirectory, which can be very long: you almost always use -s (total) and -h (readable units).

options.description: Sizes in readable units (K, M, G).
Shows only the total for each argument.
Also lists files, not just directories.
Adds a grand total at the end.
Only goes into detail down to N levels.
Shows the size of the data rather than the space used on disk.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: File(s) or directory(ies) to measure. Default: the current directory.

examples.explanation: The 5 largest entries in the current directory.
Size of each direct subdirectory of /var, from largest to smallest.
Size of a project without its dependencies.
